brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.

requirements.evidence: Build has 4 bases at 0,0,0 / 0,1,0 / 1,0,0 / 3,0,0. Bases at 0,0-0,1-1,0 are mutually adjacent touching walls, forming a 3-base cluster, not two discrete pairs. Isolated base at 3,0 creates an extra separate body. No configuration of two distinct 2-base pairs achieved.

requirements.requirement: The pairs joined to each other only with side connectors (no direct base-to-base wall adjacency between the pairs)
requirements.evidence: No side connectors are currently installed (counts: piece 4, connector 0). All adjacency present is direct wall contact, not connector-bridged. Configurator does allow side connectors, but pairs were not placed with a 1-cell gap and then bridged; current layout cannot satisfy 'only with side connectors'.

finish.summary: Build does not meet brief: it is 3 touching bases plus one isolated base with zero connectors, not two connector-only-joined pairs. No new work started per instruction; check_build is clear for mesh clash but shows LOOSE_BODY.

result.note: No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
